```{r functions, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
scientific_10 <- function(x) {
  # browser()
  # cat("X: ", x, "\n")
  y <- gsub("e-0", "e-", format(x, scientific = TRUE, trim = TRUE))
  y <- gsub("e\\+0", "e", y)
  text_labs <- gsub("e", " %*% 10^\"", paste0(y, "\""))
  # text_labs <- gsub("e", " %*% 10^", scales::math_format()(x))
  zeros <- stri_startswith_fixed(text_labs, pattern = "0 %")
  text_labs[which(zeros)] <- "0"
  zeros <- stri_startswith_fixed(text_labs, pattern = "0.0 %")
  text_labs[which(zeros)] <- "0"
  na_s <- stri_startswith_fixed(text_labs, pattern = "NA")

  text_labs[which(na_s)] <- "NA"
  str2expression(text_labs)
}

get_acquisition_params <- function(path, outfile = stderr()) {
  ds_params <- stringi::stri_split_regex(basename(path), pattern = "\\.")[[1]]
  if (length(ds_params) < 5) {
    cat(
      "Failed to obtain acquisition parameters from the path given!\n",
      file = outfile
    )
    NULL
  }
  ds_expt <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[1]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_res <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[2]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_mode <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[3]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_dev <- as.integer(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[4]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]])
  ds_dev <- ds_dev[which(!is.na(ds_dev))]
  ds_range <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[5]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  list(
    expt_id = ds_expt,
    resol_id = ds_res,
    pol_id = ds_mode,
    dev_id = ds_dev,
    mzrange_id = ds_range
  )
}
get_mass_list <- function(mass, tolerance) {
  all_mass <- sort(mass)
  all_mass_idx <- which(all_mass >= 500 & all_mass <= 1000)
  all_mass <- round(
    all_mass[all_mass_idx],
    digits = abs(floor(log10(tolerance)))
  )
  duplicated_idx <- which(duplicated(all_mass))
  if (length(duplicated_idx) > 0) {
    all_mass[-duplicated_idx]
  } else {
    all_mass
  }
}

```

# Задача

Задача заключается в определении того, как соотносятся между собой значения элементов вектора Шепли с данными о количестве опухолевых клеток в образцах.

Здесь половине строк матрицы интенсивностей, относящихся образцам с TCP = 100% и TCP = 0%, изменены метки классов на противоложные.

## Материалы и методы {.small}

```{r db.connect, eval=TRUE}
    ";database=", dbname,
```

```{r input.params}
diags_info <- rbind(
  sqlQuery(conn, paste0(getDiagQ, options$target_diag)),
  sqlQuery(conn, paste0(getDiagQ, options$base_diag))
)
if (options$base_diag == 32) {
  diags_info$description[[2]] <- "Quasi-healthy brain"
}
```

В работе используются масс-спектрометрические данные, полученные с образцов тканей головного мозга человека с диагнозами \textbf{`r diags_info$name[[1]]`} и патологии не-опухолевой природы. Данные были получены с помощью масс-спектрометра Thermo LTQ XL Orbitrap ETD (Thermo Fisher Scientific; США) с картриджной ионизацией [@Pekov2021a; @bormotov_incorporation_2023].

Предварительная обработка масс-спектрометрических данных производилась с использованием параметров, указанных в таблице \ref{tab:paramstable}. Значения параметров взяты из результатов работы по определению оптимальных значений параметров предварительной обработки [@zavorotnyuk_determining_2024].

## DataShapley stats

```{r shapleysummary,eval=TRUE}
params_table <- cbind(
  c(
    "Tissue samples number", "Features number", "Iterations number",
    "Negative Shapley-values part", "Shapley maximum value",
    "Shapley minimum value", "Train set size", "Validating set size"
  ),
  c(
    length(unique(shap_env$shap_trained_mdT$tsample)),
    ncol(shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set) - 1,
    shap_env$t,
    paste(
      format(
        100 * length(
          which(
            shap_env$shap_calculated < 0
          )
        ) / length(shap_env$shap_calculated),
        scientific = FALSE,
        digits = 4
      ),
      "%"
    ),
    format(max(shap_env$shap_calculated),
      scientific = TRUE,
      digits = 4
    ),
    format(min(shap_env$shap_calculated),
      scientific = TRUE,
      digits = 4
    ),
    nrow(shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set),
    nrow(shap_env$train_test_data$shap_test_set)
  )
)
colnames(params_table) <- c("Parameter", "Value")
```

## Calculated Shapley-TCP Scatterplot

```{r shaptcpscatter3, dev='cairo_pdf', out.height="85%", out.width="100%", cache=FALSE}
shap_diag_labels <- as.factor(shap_env$shap_trained_mdT$diagnosis)

shap_samples_distr <- data.frame(
  shap_value = shap_env$shap_calculated,
  sample_labels = shap_env$shap_trained_mdT$tsample,
  diag_label = shap_diag_labels,
  class_label = shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set$class
)
shap_samples_distr <- shap_samples_distr |>
  mutate(
    Annotation = ifelse(diag_label == class_label, TRUE, FALSE)
  )
shap_samples_distr$Scan <- "RAW"
shap_samples_distr$Scan[seq_len(nrow(all_fm_data$avg_meta_data)) + length(
  shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_idx
)] <- "AVG"
tcp_values <- shap_env$shap_trained_mdT$tcp
shap_scans_df <- cbind(
  shap_samples_distr,
  tcp_values
)
ordered_calc_shap_tcp <- shap_scans_df[
  with(shap_scans_df, order(tcp_values, sample_labels)),
]
ordered_calc_shap_tcp$sample_labels <- factor(
  ordered_calc_shap_tcp$sample_labels,
  levels = unique(ordered_calc_shap_tcp$sample_labels)
)
ggplot(
  data = ordered_calc_shap_tcp,
  aes(
    x = shap_value, y = sample_labels, colour = tcp_values, shape = Annotation
  )
) +
  facet_grid(Scan ~ class_label) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Shapley value",
    y = "Tissue samples",
    colour = "TCP",
    shape = "Annotation"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scientific_10) +
  scale_y_discrete(guide = guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)) +
  scale_shape(solid = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right",
  ) +
  scale_colour_gsea()
```

## Model training

```{r modeltrain, cache=FALSE}
tr_control <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 3)
rf_model <- train(
  shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set[, seq_len(ncol(
    shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set
  ) - 1)],
  shap_env$shap_calculated,
  #preProc = c("center", "scale"),
  method = "rf",
  trControl = tr_control,
  importance = TRUE
)
saveRDS(
  rf_model,
  file = file.path(options$work_dir, "rf_model.rds")
)
print(rf_model)
```

## Prediction rank

```{r predrank, dev='cairo_pdf', out.height="85%", out.width="100%", cache=FALSE}
predicted_shapley <- predict(rf_model$finalModel, all_fm_data$result_fm)
my_formula <- y ~ x
test_rank <- data.frame(
  target = rank(
    shap_env$shap_calculated[seq_len(
      length(shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_idx)
    )]
  ),
  predict = rank(predicted_shapley[shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_idx])
)
ggplot(data = test_rank, aes(x = target, y = predict)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se=FALSE, color="black", formula = my_formula) +
  stat_poly_eq(
    formula = my_formula,
    eq.with.lhs = "italic(hat(y))~`=`~",
    aes(label = paste(
      after_stat(eq.label),
      after_stat(rr.label),
      sep = "*plain(\",\")~"
    )),
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_jitter() +
  labs(
    x = "Target Shapley values",
    y = "Predicted Shapley values",
    title = "Rank-Rank plot"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right",
  )

```

```{r fullscatterplot2, dev='cairo_pdf', out.height="85%", out.width="100%", cache=FALSE}

avoid_overlapling <- function(x) {
  idx <- seq.int(1, length(x), by = 3)
  x[-idx] <- ""
  x
}

tsamples_parts <- ldply(
  stringi::stri_match_all_regex(
    shap_samples_distr_full$sample_labels,
    pattern = "(?<tissue>\\d+\\/\\d+)(?:\\s(?<species>\\d))?-(?<sample>\\d+)"
  ),
  function(x) {
    as.data.frame(x)
  }
)[, c("tissue", "species", "sample")]

tsamples_parts$tfact <- factor(
  tsamples_parts$tissue,
  labels = paste("PAT", sprintf("%02d", seq_along(tissues)), sep = "")
)
colors_22 <- scales::hue_pal()(
  max(
    length(tissues), length(unique(tsamples_parts$species))
  )
)
tsamples_parts <- tsamples_parts |>
  mutate(
    spec_fact = as.factor(dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(species), " A ", paste0(" ", LETTERS[as.numeric(species)], " ")
    ))
  )
tsamples_parts <- tsamples_parts |>
  mutate(
    sample_label3 = paste(
      "<span style='color:",
      colors_22[tfact], "'>",
      tfact, "</span>",
      "<span style='color:",
      colors_22[spec_fact], "'>",
      spec_fact, "</span>",
      "<span style='color:",
      colors_22[as.numeric(sample)], "'>",
      sample, "</span>",
      sep = ""
    ),
    sample_label2 = paste(
      tfact,
      spec_fact,
      sample,
      sep = ""
    )
  )
shap_samples_distr_full$sample_labels2 <- tsamples_parts$sample_label2
shap_samples_distr_full$sample_labels3 <- tsamples_parts$sample_label3
idx <- sort(shap_samples_distr_full$tcp_values, index.return = TRUE)

ordered_calc_shap_tcp <- shap_samples_distr_full[idx$ix,]
ordered_calc_shap_tcp$sample_labels2 <- factor(
  ordered_calc_shap_tcp$sample_labels2,
  levels = unique(ordered_calc_shap_tcp$sample_labels2)
)
ggplot(
  data = ordered_calc_shap_tcp,
  aes(
    x = shap_value, y = sample_labels2, colour = tcp_values, shape = diag_label
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
```

```{r fullscatterplot222, dev='cairo_pdf', out.height="85%", out.width="100%", cache=FALSE}
label_samples <- function(x) {
  # browser()
  # cat("X: ", x, "\n")?
  tsamples_parts <- ldply(
    stringi::stri_match_all_regex(
      x,
      pattern = "(?<tissue>\\d+\\/\\d+)(?:\\s(?<species>\\d))?-(?<sample>\\d+)"
    ),
    function(x) {
      as.data.frame(x)
    }
  )[, c("tissue", "species", "sample")]
  tissues <- unique(tsamples_parts$tissue)
  tsamples_parts$tfact <- factor(
    tsamples_parts$tissue,
    labels = paste("PAT", sprintf("%02d", seq_along(tissues)), sep = "")
  )
  colors_22 <- scales::hue_pal()(
    max(
      length(tissues), length(unique(tsamples_parts$species))
    )
  )
  tsamples_parts <- tsamples_parts |>
    mutate(
      spec_fact = as.factor(dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(species), " A ", paste0(" ", LETTERS[as.numeric(species)], " ")
      ))
    )
  tsamples_parts <- tsamples_parts |>
    mutate(
      sample_label3 = paste(
        "<span style='color:",
        colors_22[tfact], "'>",
        tfact, "</span>",
        "<span style='color:",
        colors_22[spec_fact], "'>",
        spec_fact, "</span>",
        "<span style='color:",
        colors_22[as.numeric(sample)], "'>",
        sample, "</span>",
        sep = ""
      ),
      sample_label2 = paste(
        tfact,
        spec_fact,
        sample,
        sep = ""
      )
    )
  idx <- seq.int(1, length(tsamples_parts$sample_label3), by = 3)
  tsamples_parts$sample_label3[-idx] <- ""
  tsamples_parts$sample_label3
}
ggplot(
  data = ordered_calc_shap_tcp,
  aes(
    x = shap_value, y = sample_labels, colour = tcp_values, shape = diag_label
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Shapley value",
    y = "Tissue samples",
    colour = "TCP",
    shape = "Diagnosis"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scientific_10) +
  # scale_y_discrete(guide = guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_samples) +
  scale_shape(solid = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2) +

  theme(
```

# Modeling with averaged data

```{r avgdatamodel}
true_idx <- which(
  shap_samples_distr$Annotation == TRUE & shap_samples_distr$Scan == "AVG"
)
avg_data_idx <- seq_along(
  shap_env$shap_calculated
)[(
  length(shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_idx) + 1
): length(shap_env$shap_calculated)
]
rf_model_avg <- train(
  shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set[
    true_idx, seq_len(ncol(
      shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set
    ) - 1)
  ],
  shap_env$shap_calculated[true_idx],
  #preProc = c("center", "scale"),
  method = "rf",
  trControl = tr_control,
  importance = TRUE
)
saveRDS(
  rf_model_avg,
  file = file.path(options$work_dir, "rf_model_avg.rds")
)
print(rf_model_avg)
```

## Prediction rank

```{r predrankavg, dev='cairo_pdf', out.height="85%", out.width="100%", cache=FALSE}
predicted_shapley_avg <- predict(
  rf_model_avg$finalModel, shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set
)
my_formula <- y ~ x
test_rank <- data.frame(
  target = rank(
    shap_env$shap_calculated[true_idx]
  ),
  predict = rank(predicted_shapley_avg[true_idx])
)
ggplot(data = test_rank, aes(x = target, y = predict)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se=FALSE, color="black", formula = my_formula) +
  stat_poly_eq(
    formula = my_formula,
    eq.with.lhs = "italic(hat(y))~`=`~",
    aes(label = paste(
      after_stat(eq.label),
      after_stat(rr.label),
      sep = "*plain(\",\")~"
    )),
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_jitter() +
  labs(
    x = "Target Shapley values",
    y = "Predicted Shapley values",
    title = "Rank-Rank plot on averaged data"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right",
  )

```

## Prediction rank (Precentile)

```{r predrankavgpercent, dev='cairo_pdf', out.height="85%", out.width="100%", cache=FALSE}
df_a <- data.frame(
  shap_a = shap_env$shap_calculated, scan = shap_env$shap_trained_mdT$idx
)
df_b <- data.frame(
  shap_b = predicted_shapley_avg[true_idx],
  scan = shap_env$shap_trained_mdT$idx[true_idx]
)

merged_df <- inner_join(df_a, df_b, by = "scan")

merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_A = percent_rank(shap_a),
    Rank_B = percent_rank(shap_b)
  )

ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = shap_a, y = shap_b)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se=FALSE, color="red",slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", formula = my_formula) +
  stat_poly_eq(
    formula = my_formula,
    eq.with.lhs = "italic(hat(y))~`=`~",
    aes(label = paste(
      after_stat(eq.label),
      after_stat(rr.label),
      sep = "*plain(\",\")~"
    )),
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Rank-Rank Plot (Percentile Ranks)",
    x = "Rank in Calculated shapley (Percentile)",
    y = "Rank in Predicted shapley (Percentile)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
  )

```
